name: TinyUSB Generic Gamepad (RP2040/ESP32)
notes: 68-byte descriptor. Source: TinyUSB TUD_HID_REPORT_DESC_GAMEPAD (src/class/hid/hid_device.h) with its optional report ID, here 2, the report ID this profile has always carried, then the layout of hid_gamepad_report_t: 8-bit X, Y, Z, Rz, Rx and Ry from -127 to 127, an 8-bit hat from 1 to 8 and 32 buttons. RP2040, ESP32 and STM32 firmware built on TinyUSB uses it. The descriptor before held an input and a feature report that were not whole bytes, which Windows' HID parser refuses (HIDP_GETCOLDESC_BYTE_ALLIGN).

layout.note: TinyUSB stack reference gamepad descriptor (the test device, not a physical product). The descriptor shape is the canonical hid_gamepad_report_t from the TinyUSB library: 2 sticks + Z + Rz + Rx + Ry + 8-bit hat + 32 buttons. Authoring deferred: no manufacturer-published 'design' separate from the descriptor.
